claims.claim: RenderHub's Content Licensing agreement (https://www.renderhub.com/info/3d-content-licensing, full text read 2026-09-23) says the Extended Use License "permits both non-commercial and commercial use of the Digital Asset" and lists among its permitted uses "Computer games and software (computer/web/mobile games, virtual and augmented worlds, simulation and training environments, software user interfaces, electronic textbooks)"; the Personal Use Only License "permits only non-commercial use". Under Unauthorized Uses, which apply to both licences, "you may not redistribute, publish or make a Digital Asset available to any third party unless the Digital Asset becomes part of a larger Creation" (a Creation is defined as any work created by you), the same condition applies to a modified Digital Asset, and a Competition clause reads: "You may not use or distribute the Digital Asset, or any modified version of the Digital Asset, in any way that is competitive with the original Digital Asset or the Site, or in any way that displaces the market for the original Digital Asset", with uploading it "to another digital content marketplace" as an example. The agreement does not require encryption or any protection against extraction of the files in a shipped game; its only security duty is that collaborators and clients a licensee shares an asset with "must take reasonable care to secure the Digital Asset". It has no clause on AI or machine learning; the site's separate AI Policy page governs AI-made listings and posts, not buyers' use. The page ends with "Rev: 2022.02.10", but that line is not a reliable version date: it is absent from Wayback snapshots of Aug 2023 and Aug and Nov 2025, and the text changed between 2023 and 2025. The Green Dragon for Genesis 8 Male item page shows an "Extended Use License" badge and a single displayed price of US$10.00 (2026-09-23), with no separate licence add-on price.
